body:
| | | |
---
Good evening. Tonight is deadline night, and tomorrow my team will meet to discuss our fundraising numbers, which has a direct impact on our budget. It’s critical that we show that we have the resources to run a competitive campaign. New York is an expensive state to run in — and our opponent, Mike Lawler, has a big leg up over us in terms of money. But forget about that for a moment. I want to talk about why I’m in this race to begin with. I was a junior in high school on 9/11 when the Twin Towers fell. The next day, I began my West Point application. After graduating, I did six overseas deployments serving in combat zones like Iraq and Afghanistan. I did that out of a love for this country. Back then, I never thought that the greatest threat to America’s future would come from within our own borders. But the people running this administration do not share our values – or the values of the generations of Americans who fought and sacrificed to make this country better. **So I made the decision to run for Congress, again, out of love for this country.** My opponent, Mike Lawler, has become a rubber stamp for Trump and the MAGA agenda. Our campaign has a clear path to beating him and flipping this seat. But it’s going to be a tough fight. So please. [I am respectfully asking you to donate $10 or even $17 before midnight tonight. The only way we’ll be able to fire Lawler and take back the House is with your help. body:
This goes far beyond politics. The fabric of America is unweaving. | | | | | A Personal Message From Mike
---
Friend,
---
I am reaching out to you directly because, quite frankly, I don't know where else to turn. I've spent the last few hours pacing the room, trying to process what is happening. The latest developments are incredibly daunting, and my heart is heavy with an overwhelming sense of urgency.
---

**It is reality.** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=200d0bb1f2184ed0a6b907932679e9c2&_e=275K1ypUWZAhSOPybBeQBFLNFv2JwltcDfMz60hWCXNGQGEY5gZtF8X3U4tLlAZlOWu2U8nA8iEANdq-4PurAhZFUlxYYgQdF3diqxmEL3n7fddZJG1KOYhJSzgE3vpZZENRK_K8ITl6xXwJ6dkcUXJTLv7kbiELZ41rViQyk7gvRXzf71tcCZyrLeGnD0VaESxSnt2ILcEPs3JZOiCOIQtAVBHPounegoGaHdhEDaczBiS_EeaeiFobtJ12oNLl1Wp_DSKRIgzI0xXhslsxbJzilq3PgpjQ19aahgWg0ttgo2nGkx4lEvK2iWrTCgjwiSEs6rzuv9pexE9bfg1zjfbdDRxPdgRyBoB5tLNbwRkpdrHqTzQaN1L9Q8SjfU5iNTo1XlDGOn2aJE9tnG0JpVPRoDMQCsRSBJ7Umd4UzE-GkH8Eanj2wk40EFIhkLxx5qcfe6N3LQv5tn9sX4nnzDBHSJwD7X0Bw3n16cBJamScpANTEmpNgFyTzfupugDT4OFINqsqiNjp42eSoRixl25HmqFvVaBQ9aDYR9Qlb15q9eBQz2eIEZhsnLUoZdDIvTuGvOscHC6H0vzIMmJEyWjoIVhEZJLHCsJyhsRv-eR_ZkwdRBBjvMT6Hd2cLXMffVMUEGtn7OdCj_C98arllWKt_PkrlbB30HMYBw2atlhzTVmioDz7bGulpyXH6M9Yb8mdjHBlbo12EF5utevOAwK49SQ-JGOvVAjBm1mIdS8GtTKtV551j7c4vLxkvQmu3DkbYzQUtMxc6ytUIOI5wXbNJcXRulU2uGg_HEHYUwA%3D)

Now we must win again. And we will win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.

subject: Checking back in
body:
Hi there, I appreciate you opening this message.
I’m reaching out one last time today because our July end-of-month deadline is just a few hours away at midnight.
I just checked in with my finance team, and we are still falling short of the budget target we set for tonight.
I'm not going to beat around the bush: The NRCC is watching our numbers closely. When you represent a seat that was decided by less than a thousand votes, every benchmark is a public test of our campaign’s strength.
National Republicans are counting on a mid-summer slowdown. They want nothing more than to see us miss our target so they can declare CA-45 vulnerable and flood our community with more outside money.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Gregg Hull - Unfiltered
body:
His plans for New Mexico and his TIGHT race against Haaland | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/qyuoQ3RoBxQ?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | | New Mexico put a 15-year-old boy in a car, drove him to El Paso, and told him to walk across the bridge into Mexico by himself.

So who signed off on that?

That's the first thing we asked **Gregg Hull** on Wednesday. He was mayor of Rio Rancho for 12 years and he's the Republican running for governor against Deb Haaland.

**We had him for**[**a full hour**](https://us.list-manage.com/T8HlNEe0v_u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)**and asked LOTS of important questions. He didn't dodge any of it**
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/16fLZTGJXRo?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | **🚨 THE STATE WALKED A BOY TO THE MEXICAN BORDER AND LEFT HIM THERE**

CYFD is the agency that's supposed to protect New Mexico kids. They had custody of this one and drove him to the border anyway. Then Texas found him and called CYFD to hand him back.

What the agency said next is the part that set Gregg off, and you need to hear him read it out loud. He's asking for something now that nobody in Santa Fe is going to want to hand over.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/ntYV0R10B5J?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **💰 HULL WANTS TO END THE STATE INCOME TAX. THAT'S $2.2 BILLION BACK TO US.**

Everybody in Santa Fe says you can't do that unless you raise some other tax to cover it. Gregg says that's wrong, and he works the numbers right there on the show. It comes down to the oil and gas money and one thing about a dollar that most people never think about.

And that $250 check the governor keeps talking about? Don't spend it yet. Mark explains why.

**🏛️ HE'S BEING OUTSPENT SEVEN TO ONE AND SAYS THE RACE IS TIED

** Haaland won her primary decisively and has significantly outraised Gregg so far. Mark pointed out that if this race stays competitive, it’s likely Gregg will face attacks from the other side. During the interview, Mark asked how Gregg plans to respond if and when that happens. Gregg laid out his strategy. Take a listen.
**🔥 WE ASKED HIM THE ABORTION QUESTION EVERYBODY EMAILS US ABOUT

** Can a governor end abortion in New Mexico? Krysty asked it flat out. His answer is honest, and plenty of people may not like it.

It also tells you exactly where to aim if you want this changed.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/57fGgsNDvke?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Some thoughts.
body:
Hi Peter, it’s
Gina. I know it’s late, but I wanted to reach out and share some thoughts
I’ve had on my mind.

We are officially less than 100 days away from Election Day.

In just 14 weeks, Texans will decide what kind of future we want for our
state — and there’s still so much work left to do.

Right now, our team is on the ground across Texas, organizing in
communities big and small, talking with voters, and building the
grassroots movement it will take to win this race.

But we can’t slow down now.

Taking on Greg Abbott and his corporate backers isn’t going to be easy. I
know that. I know they’ll spend whatever it takes to hold onto power.

But that’s why this moment matters.

Every conversation we have. Every volunteer we train. Every voter we
reach. Every dollar raised brings us one step closer to building the
campaign Texas deserves.

I know what this team is capable of when we come together. We’ve already
shown that this movement is powered by everyday Texans who believe our
state can be better.

So before you put your phone or computer away for the night, will you make
a contribution today to help us keep organizing, keep growing, and keep

body:
How many politicians know what it’s like to be a regular Texan?

| | | [ ](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=uGD1_JWQzocUoO6G1sZMF-tYIAuKQ97Z_lDiPedGAn11JJNENg30eeUPXVkqayxCfDLIkkjdPcC_U3XuHRoCIwMELeQenzQ2oHmoOYJU340&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=1)
---
How many politicians know what it’s like to be a regular Texan? Grit is such a defining characteristic of Texan culture. In the past month or so, I’ve had my home’s AC unit replaced, plumbing repairs, and my beloved vehicle needed to be towed to the shop for major repairs... ha, oh, and a roofer is coming Monday. And I’m preparing to be back in the classroom Monday with my new first graders. Pushing through all of it, though, I find myself so grateful for the love, support, and resources to keep moving forward. I am humbled to know that too many Texans are struggling even more than my working family is. Thank you for sharing your stories and our campaign with people you know. Below, find upcoming events, hot topics, opportunities to help, and more! **_
Upcoming Events at a Glance_** _Next Saturday, August 8th_ | Kyle Market Day with [KBAD](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=gtygs8y15la-QqWnug14PNoDd0n4pCDy60p3H6wSXmf_nfQZ0LgAnZxW8E6XYUd_&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=2) \- Kyle-Buda Area Democrats will be at this adorable farmers and artisan market. Come say hi at the KBAD booth! _August 16th_ | Sign up for upcoming events like our [South Austin Meet & Greet](https://www.tanyafortx27.com/meet_greet_shady_hollow?e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=3). Add your event to our calendar by emailing samantha@herdingcatscampaigns.com
---
**_Last Week's Highlights_** **__** ⏰ NEW POLL RESULTS: James Talarico is leading against Ken Paxton by 5 points! This is not a fluke. 53% of the respondents voted for Trump in 2024. **That means MAGA is losing support. And rapidly.** The opportunity to flip Texas is _very_ real, and we need to take advantage up and down the ballot. Like Talarico, I’m a teacher, so I’ve sat with parents when they tell me they lost their health insurance. Like Talarico, I’m fighting for universal healthcare and childcare so that Texas families can thrive. And like Talarico, I’m ready to take on my MAGA fanatic opponent who only cares about one thing: making Donald Trump happy. By investing in our TX-27 race, you are helping Democrats at all levels. We’re building the ground game to get voters to the polls. **_We have yard signs available!_** If you would like one and live in District 27, please fill out this [form](https://www.tanyafortx27.com/volunteer?e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=4). We are making upgrades to our website. Everything you need to know before you vote: [Voter Info](https://www.tanyafortx27.com/voter_info?e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=5) Please feel free to forward this newsletter to your network! And as always, thank you for being a part of this campaign. We are grateful for y'all's support!! To stay updated, please check out our socials—we appreciate the follows! [Instagram](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=mGkj6P31KIkRMZhtjQusDTV7GFpUpg6VLLUuif8PWjnWOC4lSKuv8GWqaLwO5DvX&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=6) [Facebook](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=gtygs8y15la-QqWnug14POmyE7cVjhGFcY_EAyuu8aYPN63MFjBoN881CO180NQWdZbpMYdzMIJrmMZDpBHNwA&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=7) [Website](https://www.tanyafortx27.com/?e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=8) If you’d like to make a contribution, please visit: [actblue.com](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=uGD1_JWQzocUoO6G1sZMF-tYIAuKQ97Z_lDiPedGAn0XlvDo1X5NteDsJeOxzSIjywkdl8c2iNfTRzSvzGQb3Lve33NPnNz8OExPjAj5OKSkzhflpUG_7fanJMwvDnQJ&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_3&n=9). subject: FBI Projects 158-Year Wait for “Hidden Room” Records
body:
VA Removes 6,531 Noncitizens from Voter Rolls

[INSIDE JW]

FBI SAYS IT WILL TAKE 158 YEARS TO PROCESS “HIDDEN ROOM” RECORDS

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38391&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS8zRVVVaEJEX1hXUT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=ef23ebed76feb8862e5e727f5fd5ad2260f609d89f1e17be725911757895624d]

This is simply amazing. The FBI has told a federal court that, at a
rate of 500 pages a month, processing records from the “hidden
room” at FBI Headquarters would take approximately 158 years.

The room — now dubbed the “burn bag room” — holds over 2
million pages of records, according to the FBI’s own filing.
Then-Deputy Director Bongino said in May 2025 that some of the records
were found stashed “in bags.”

The figures came in a
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38392&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWpvaW50LXN0YXR1cy1yZXBvcnQtMDQwNDcvXUpvaW50P3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=a88f1108296b1f436f88b9bda41f4a40188fe025f4013b976d89941d1dbaf2ca

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38387&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWpvaW50LXN0YXR1cy1yZXBvcnQtMDQwNDcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=3d334629846ab6a51a21cc8122b8676f2b59cd7a2ed9d769bb69efbda81042a9]
filed July 30, 2026, in our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA)
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38393&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZiaS1oaWRkZW4tcm9vbS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDQwNDcvXWxhd3N1aXQ/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=1f340340207cf0eaf7551eb3f7181bee92ee5cd3c80b395e24ec99ba9819441a
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=36534&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZiaS1oaWRkZW4tcm9vbS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDQwNDcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=80d264cad517ad6f0db22e99ece3ef1c3b477dffbfe2e657465e7ec8dc8f9b9a]
against the Department of Justice (_Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department
of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=36534&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZiaS1oaWRkZW4tcm9vbS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDQwNDcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=80d264cad517ad6f0db22e99ece3ef1c3b477dffbfe2e657465e7ec8dc8f9b9a]
(No. 1:25-cv-04047)).

In the filing, we
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38394&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWpvaW50LXN0YXR1cy1yZXBvcnQtMDQwNDctcGdzLTItNC9dYXNrZWQ/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=b27eb9b4a99c77197942cc99a632e35592685d936b527803a72e0b1501965186
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38388&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWpvaW50LXN0YXR1cy1yZXBvcnQtMDQwNDctcGdzLTItNC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=594d2d27f13554dddb4dfc66e1b3fd31f990c7e569dd102e41047da2762e4a83]
the court to allow it to question the FBI, through a limited
deposition, about its handling of the records — including who
discovered the room and when, who had access to it, its security
classification, how records ended up stored in file cabinets, safes,
boxes, and burn bags, what the FBI has done to bring them under
standard records management, and whether the records were ever
searched in response to other FOIA requests.

The FBI reports that it has yet to access a safe believed to contain
records. The agency also
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38395&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWpvaW50LXN0YXR1cy1yZXBvcnQtMDQwNDctcGctNS9dYWxsZWdlcz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=a3ddf132676077ff2fbf49ee1bc40ebf6b4e78677dc87977b38b58428f22cc1f
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38389&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWpvaW50LXN0YXR1cy1yZXBvcnQtMDQwNDctcGctNS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=1ea3d493f65288d8d2f3abb292422f0c9734c76e0eec4fa0c6a708e19478f221]
that “it will take approximately 158 years to process at a rate of
500 pages a month.”

The FBI opposes the request for discovery. A status conference is
scheduled before U.S. District Judge Dabney L. Friedrich on August 3,
2026 in Washington, DC.

Our 2025 complaint sought all records in the room, which it described
as _“[a]ll documents referenced by Deputy Director Dan Bongino”_
concerning a room at FBI Headquarters, as well as internal FBI
communications among officials in the offices of Director Kash Patel
and Deputy Director Bongino about the discovery of the documents, and
any directives issued on how the records should be handled. The FBI
currently says it has no records responsive to the Patel/Bongino
communications and directives categories. The plaintiff is challenging
the government’s search for these records as well.

In a Fox News interview on May 29, 2025, then-FBI Deputy Director
Bongino disclosed the room’s existence, stating:

> _“There was a room [in FBI Headquarters], and we found stuff. A
> lot of stuff ... hidden from us at least and not mentioned to us.
> And then found stuff in there. A lot is from the Comey era. We are
> working ... right now to declassify. And just so you know, because I
> get the public—I totally understand people saying ‘well do it
> now.’ The process is: not all of the information is ours to

to respond to a March 24, 2026, FOIA request seeking:

> All records in any form related to the former FBI Director, Robert
> Swan Mueller, III, born on August 7, 1944, in New York City, NY, who
> died on March 20, 2026.

Mueller served as FBI director from September 2001 to September 2013.
During his tenure, the FBI significantly expanded its domestic
surveillance authorities. Among other powers, the bureau made
extensive use of expanded authorities under the USA PATRIOT Act of
2001, including National Security Letters
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38318&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9vaWcuanVzdGljZS5nb3Yvc2l0ZXMvZGVmYXVsdC9maWxlcy9hcmNoaXZlL3NwZWNpYWwvczA3MDgvaW5kZXguaHRtP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=ea154cf38c1023edd6f9bd702d6ff6e9d52fbb93d98edbc677600922b0d08bb3],
which allowed the FBI to compel the production of financial,
telecommunications and internet records without prior judicial
approval while often prohibiting recipients from disclosing the
requests.

Three years after Mueller left the FBI, the bureau launched
“Crossfire Hurricane
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38319&F=T&&hash=4f2bfc887b25297772cfd7a03cf30a721d2d9e1eac5943494937113789aed680
also known as “Russiagate,” into allegations of links between
Donald Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign and Russia. Then-Deputy
Attorney General Rod Rosenstein appointed Mueller as special counsel
in May 2017 to continue the investigation. Mueller served in that role
until March 2019.

Mueller’s investigation concluded
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38320&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3RoZS1tdWVsbGVyLXJlcG9ydC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=e1cc8f07ddbc5076d0e09dbe26444d947d9db90dc75a3f075c56a29aeb130a3e] that it
“did not establish that members of the Trump Campaign conspired or
coordinated with the Russian government in its election interference
activities.”

In May 2023, Special Counsel John Durham concluded
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38321&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVzdGljZS5nb3YvYXJjaGl2ZXMvc2NvLWR1cmhhbS9tZWRpYS8xMzgxMjExL2RsP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=8310d7a05ea98578f8b2502873b05cea55be473d4c5abe81d926efe9a294ca12] that
the FBI failed to uphold its mission of “strict fidelity to the
law” when pursuing Crossfire Hurricane and found that the bureau
lacked sufficiently corroborated information to justify opening a full
investigation.

In March 2025, President Trump issued a memorandum
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84518&L=38322&F=T&&hash=56815333013c48fc8fc05dc5f270787a64c93112cefafe81b17b3aa14431f08b],

## Hamas Agrees to Disarm in Gaza
President Trump announced a [historic agreement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAUhJ8GOiP7YAIULrahy7ZbohN8DF75T7YTlPv0V-Q-wm1nNKP55t99vaN1Nux_0ZOqJq6BzuKoVsrrgR4L7pmo1KhtweyF8Na5FTjcGJ8YF6tG696rbLUyREB9S0qM0zCM0zxAeyiYh36TPcjZSGkQAMzjNpkZNmm0RN1adbXxiQvB-Sx4J0c-G00T0qMfCaiRnLStMXf_ow31IOPe8UW526JvnTpqTaXp_zSwNLCc59mFx3ZRXP6lxOx0A8uOX9jAUvPTJ1bwXVgi3Iglh4Gd1jnmCDX7QLMfWvQUKrMlIzlWninFXNkzbJRZ3gIOMxeDaLPS6crbchsbyXeP1n221V8d-lLwHQAA__-4UYwR) for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all other armed groups in Gaza, calling it a "major milestone" in his 20-point peace plan. The deal, brokered by Egypt, Qatar and Turkey through Trump's [Board of Peace](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2K6zAQBeCnkTsFaSxbdqHiwsVwi9x2SzOxxrYW_RhJScg-_RLvI2w3MHA43_m4zld03sXtPwYydU1zpGfxVCvleceABbdMVGqyrmAOUgbn_QwCei4GLuRs0fnXrBprViKgtiEj9dB1ehg7aHZjCRarEEetxtsIVupeCwtrT3ZRGobGmXeaGISUQoxSXJQW42ppQLq1moCYEmRdTfnymVysO63-lR6UL0sKjTd7rUdh7R8GE4MJb8tb8P4xmP7FSjlidSmiZzDVfA8HxxjTPS5U-CnkPzQMFCs_ued1YK58wy_kB-FCDKZSU36xdnKWtX9l24HqeymabOzxdN670mumxBbQ-bNb_dWgDwPfAQAA___FhYsk), calls for weapons to be surrendered in phases, after which Israeli forces would withdraw and an International Stabilization Force would deploy alongside a new Palestinian police force. Hamas officials said they would only disarm if Israel honors its [ceasefire commitments](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSsyAcBPCn0Q4HUNEUFF-TLl97pfNXFuUOxAESJ_f0N8k9wvU7O_vbj9t0I-fdvv6nAF1snHac2aMUpGmjQJnWBOQSjcuUghDBeT9JLhXjI-NiMuT8c-pqoy0g0dbQYhj7fhgvvaw33bejRG-XVinFweUsrFJQAlBtN9u5dvrVxkcuBOcXwZtu4BdrMBLmdoBE1XEYV2JqPqPbywbrn_GB1Cwx1F5vpRy5av9V8lrJ63mezYtwAl-vQCWvJd3DwRZPLmQ2R0qGRcsO0AKWQMuGzAzIsxLZr5K95Yx2wxLmu_OGrfRNTEiphp6PddLmOJ33Lquh6vgayPn3nPKnDx9a_gQAAP__bviGfw), including ending attacks and increasing aid. Israel has not officially responded, and key timelines remain unclear.
## F-35 Fighter Crashes in San Diego
A Marine Corps [F-35B fighter jet crashed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAYhJ9GOwwgihYU19jttVeaX_jRfwOyAbJm3_7ivcJ1k0xmJvP9PNYHUKBz_4aIpvq0nniVgLViXg-IUGDPiKUmRwVyFCJSCKvkcmR8YlysDih8VtU64xEl9i0aoadh0NM8yPYwI6reOufVDG5TwmtwvcDNDnr0ysLQkrnb-MSF4HwWvFOaz97hBLj1GiU2iqOjmnL3THTWA334pDfmzqbYBnPU-ipN_9XIpZHLdV2d3cr94vYbudyykYtn_cA87UfFzJ5Ymc1QDlbgZI5wTyxShgiZRch0IrMpv-5cm417XRQClVE3iu8RKPxN13_xehv5GwAA___hXIBX) near the runway at Air Station Miramar in San Diego Friday morning, sparking a fire that scorched a football-field-sized patch of ground. The pilot ejected and was recovered. The Marines [classified the incident](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE8DWSPbYGwCB5uQzaYbosY00LM2jGzvoLn9iq9_g589qaRS1fvzmB7IgY_tN0ZyZT2ng64cqBRK044RM26JKJdz4YwpShk5hEkJ1YOwIOS0IIfP1NWLW4kUtTU5aazWxg5a1buzc4-z1vM8GNmiJ4Otp1546werUcua3d0mrJBSiEGKpjNiWBeySHNrSFHVCVq4nKl5nnyUndbwOd-UGn_GOri9lFeu2l-VGis1XtfVHLO_X9x5pcYbKzX-y_BNK7QaVt72QgmeVMAnzDtlyHjAwrSdkF-Y_mZYORFEThgxAXKCGTNB8gfqQSjT1cktr4tD4NybqhNbRA5fs8qPXL6d-h8AAP__sT-JQQ) as a "Class A mishap," the most severe designation, reserved for crashes involving death, permanent disability, or damage exceeding $2.5 million. The pilot is reported to be in stable condition. [Aerial footage](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uxCAQhJ8Gdz7B-gdcUKRxd2lTWntmsTcBcwJ0l3v7yFHeIOVIoxl938d1uSIHPrZ3jGSrT8tBzxKoVsrLjhELbpmo1OS4YI5KRQ5hAQljK00r1eKQw2vpG2c9EVDXkFXaDIM20wDNbsHJmxwNGbxNvh-M7sD5VQ-jmyaEbm3YnmvSSKWknJS89FpO3pFBunWagEQvyXFN-fKZ-Kg7-fBKD8qXNcUm2L3WexHdm4BZwOzT91DwcExbOgsC5pNIwBzSiqH9CyWmL2o9Z2rjiqWNnDFiFjA32br7k0PgMmrRyy0ih9-r-i8_Dws_AQAA__8mCnmv) showed the jet in at least two pieces as crews doused the wreckage with fire retardant. Each F-35 costs roughly $100 million. The incident is under investigation.
## Migrants Surge into Spain, Killing Over 50
As many as [60,000 migrants](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_O3CAQBPCnwR2nZf2_oEhjKcWXJkVKaw3LmQib04Lu5LePnFf46pFGv5k_X-sXxRTP5y862NaQ15M_JXGtLOtOBxV6CnOp2cdCchhzxJRWBBw0TBrM6imma-0abwMzctuwNePU9-M099jsdgpE3kPnhxAw9BBm57vWuYGwpxmgifZugwmMAZgNPLoR5uB5It7akZFVB-xjzfL4m-NZdw7pym-Wh8tHk-xe66uo9ofCReFCm7sX3JnC5edZWU6qMZ-UFC6fKPy7ZrkULmbSPrKmUFn0Jkxu11sWz6KPLNm5rMuLzlh2XVnkBlzatD32iACNWP_6xJRiGUbVwfOgmP6L6rdufFv8FwAA__-lGIgQ) surged from Morocco into Spain's Ceuta territory in 24 hours, killing at least 57 in the tiny North African enclave of 84,000 residents. Images showed mostly young men swimming around border fences and sprinting through streets. Some drowned; others died in a [stampede at Tarajal beach](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ8GOyaAOmhBsY3dbLulucpF2ADXADMT337jvsJfn-Q753x_XusLQgz5-A0JTXO0ZvzWiK1hWT0kqHAUxNrIhgolSZlCjKsS6snFxIVcLYR4rUNnjUNU2HdopJ7GUU_zqDpveruNDvT-BNWPvZ5gm90o9kEOTs-4zV0wN01MQkohZikegxazszgBbr1GhWwQaEOj8vhLITePLl70wfLYKXXR-NbOyvpfTC1MLfk6qbY7Ymq5wUwtQjO19IKp5UslWn5fZGppnt4Vsq2cHE_hKJBb5eVdPa8n5FA936hYLPwslM4W8sF3iJE7KjxDC5QhckxYDsz7xWGrFN8N-e6B7oKuGHt-Q4yhPjUbxJEgxP-r249Uf4z6FwAA__-SeJS6). Ceuta's president called for a national emergency, but Madrid denied it. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez visited Friday, blaming human smugglers for exploiting a recent court ruling. Most have already returned to Morocco, officials said, but reception centers remain overwhelmed. The [White House criticized Spain's](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ8GOiNjSDCFi9uky223RAYfw6z8k7WdsHn7lfcVthpp5tOnOefjvtw1OQr7f-2hio1LwJkdSkFaDu111nsCcomGsk6-7z05twguroxLxvvFaHLvZWyNsoDA0EL1k7xcJjlfRHuoaTNXKVe9DhyQs7DzJkcM07pKMY9Wt6SqjUve95zPPe_Gic_WQGqswwSBZuQwVGLqPiOFcsC6d3whdVv0rVNHKY_cDP8acWvE7TzPzsbvmqLe6yYmZ-o8qIAd8ZnBVqdzySw_dKB8sL3qgkcorFRAB5OZpz3pUKln2sFsip75mOK2RQaPtCNsb5bw9UQuzCAQTJuUeZzkHOXr1Ix895rc75_lT-W-lPgJAAD__4NOk6s) "far left, globalist policies" for the border collapse, urging other governments to tighten immigration restrictions.

A new [Fox News poll](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp8GOwwgzGhBsY3dv-2W5gpXvQkjRG5G5-03ziv89UnOl-_8-5l-gBLt6194oedrydOOZ03IjMfEkOCgkBNCpH0tcHHeOZcyGWUeUvVS6SkCpc9km-hnFQfdoNfP3rne6KdtNj9bq8BErQJo16ObwxwGM_QOhs457Bryt0z1SmutjDNteMxRB4Wz7QbjuiCswkicj5Y3ZLygLumT33i0Ib-a5DfmUkX3R5hRmPE8z3bJ1_3i5sKMJSdiClWYccmXvIksOSW55iIjvalS3qusGxSUX7-suAOjPCBgc_hYTkqJ6uMprFpfQOm7zL_r9fbmfwAAAP__sd2COg) of Texas registered voters shows Democrat James Talarico leading Republican Ken Paxton 51% to 48% in the U.S. Senate race. The 3-point gap sits inside the margin of error. It's the second poll in a week to show Talarico ahead, after Texas Public Opinion Research put him up 45% to 40% Tuesday. Talarico draws 68% of independents and 98% of Democrats, while 89% of Republicans back Paxton. About one in four non-MAGA Republicans said they'd vote for Talarico. Nearly 4 in 10 voters named inflation as the top issue in their Senate vote, and 2 in 10 named immigration. Texas hasn't [sent a Democrat to the Senate](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ygzAQhJ9GdGIkIX5cqEhD57QpmUM6jDJniYGzwW-fwZk8Qfqdb_fbr-twhUgx3T7hjo6PKQ8J942QGdeBgWCNPhNCiOm2wME5cV6WwSjTSNVJpYcAkV6DLYIbVbjoAp1uu7rujG5tMTsYNZp2BK_8pLvKogdV-fECXfAq2LqI7oSpTmmtlalN6ZsxaK9wtNXF1JUXVmGInNeSZ2Q8YJvolZ-4lj7fC3Iz87KJ6kOYXph-3_dyyodp5vzYOKczJEyPhJ5jTsL0f1by10dumIBRruBRvvFyyUTy-0EveU4rVheWPRLFrWmFVbc7RHp38_8eezrzEwAA__87IILS) since 1988.
## Weekend Front Nudges the Heat Down
A [weak summer cold front](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOnDAQBOCnMZ3R2piDK1ykofvTpkSLvYB1xkZmOe7ePiKvkHo0n0bz52f8wRBDWn7jRpY_cx4TXUckZiojY8QSXI6EPqRlxw_nxHnfRw36IaGXoEaPIX5HU3k7gX-qiqzq-rbttepMtVoyfTtNzrgOnn3TkgfjJkT0vjdmBlUFe2PQg1IKdKtr95i8ckCTaZ66bZwwQD5wLjWvxPTBY47f_KZSu7xV0a7M-yGaX0IPQg_XddUvLnSHQg-3LfQAndBDA0IPx7ltVKTL0cuUWa6Z5VxyYnmFGOVUCF_y3OVKyPIiuRDLLSdeJZ7LebA8k6dy4VfooSrW73ctHI9OGFg2DPHfKv6_L99W_w0AAP__8A2JuQ) will slide into North, Northeast, and East Texas this weekend, dropping highs from the upper 90s into the lower 90s by Sunday. The heat dome that has run the state all week is shifting west toward Arizona, Nevada, and California, opening the door for northerly winds on its eastern edge. East Texas counties sat under heat advisories through Friday evening with heat indices near 105 degrees. Behind the front, morning lows should fall into the lower 70s, with a few upper 60s early next week. Houston gets less of a break. Forecasters there expect highs [near 100 today](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OozAUhZ_GdEb2xfwVLrahy7ZbImPfwFUMRuYmJG-_YmbeYNqj7_zo_LuNN0eRtvmvW9Hy-57GDc8jIjPmkV10mXyK6AJt8-7enDZO-z6CgkaqTio9BkfxM5oi2EmFXhdoddvVdQe6NcVipwZ6h7rWxt1N13dt0FhPvvLT1GvTQkH2ClOd0lorqKH0zRS0VziZqoe68sIoDMQpl7wg49sd9_hJL8ylT2sR7cK8H6L6I2AQMJznWfpI_gFLeh6ctou6dHS8YBYwXHUCBtUKGColYAhumzGn5yEXdCznTPshf9zyJF4kZ9ojykAz8TcU0ooyJv_AIGkTMBTZhv2kGOloWmHUvDqKXwv5d7--LPwPAAD__1Krjcs) and upper 90s next week, with overnight lows close to 80.
